{{Top}} {{Update|[[The Art of Star Wars Rebels]]}} {{Character |type=Corporate |image=[[File:Proach_CC.png]] |name=Proach |homeworld= |birth= |death=[[1 BBY]]{{RebelsDate|408}}, [[Crawler 413-24]], [[Lothal]]{{Rebels|Crawler Commandeers}} |species=[[Trandoshan]]{{Databank|guild-slave-master-proach|Guild Slave Master Proach}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]] |pronouns=He/him |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes=[[Color|Orange]] |skin=Green |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=[[Mining Guild]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|I told them the foreman would be no match for a Jedi.''"
"''Foreman? Let's hope you're right!|Cikatro Vizago and Kanan Jarrus|}} '''Proach''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Trandoshan]] who served as a [[foreman]] in the [[Mining Guild]] on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]] in [[1 BBY]]. When the [[Spectres]] [[Hijacking of Crawler 413-24|hijacked]] [[crawler 413-24]], the foreman [[Unarmed combat|fought]] briefly against the [[Lasat]] [[Garazeb Orrelios]] before falling to his [[death]]. ==Biography== ===A violent approach=== {{Quote|Drop the weapon and step away from my friend, you knuckle-brained lizard.|Garazeb Orrelios threatens Proach|}} [[File:ForemanProach-SWZ.png|thumb|left|270px|Proach piloted a TIE/mg fighter against a C-ROC ''Gozanti''-class cruiser]] Proach was a [[Trandoshan]] [[Gender|male]] who worked for the [[Mining Guild]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. At some point during his employment with the Guild, Proach piloted a [[TIE/mg Mining Guild starfighter]] in an attack on a [[C-ROC Gozanti-class light cruiser|C-ROC ''Gozanti''-class cruiser]].{{FFGXW2|set=Mining Guild TIE Expansion Pack|cardname=Foreman Proach}} In the [[Standard year|year]] [[1 BBY]], he was serving as a Guild [[Slavery|Slave]] Master and [[foreman]] on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]], overseeing the slaves that worked on the [[ore crawler]]s that the Guild were using to strip resources from the planet's surface for the Empire. Proach was onboard [[crawler 413-24]] in Lothal's southern hemisphere when the crawler was [[Hijacking of Crawler 413-24|boarded]] by the [[Spectres]], a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] operatives hoping to use the vehicle's long-range [[transmitter]]. The Rebels managed to capture the crawler's [[Captain]] [[Seevor]] and take control of the vehicle's [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] while Proach was in the rear half of the crawler with the slaves. After the Rebels saw that an internal communication had been sent from the rear, the [[Jedi]] [[Kanan Jarrus]] and the [[Lasat]] [[Garazeb Orrelios]] moved to the back section of the crawler to investigate, splitting up as they entered. Jarrus discovered the slaves, including his friend [[Cikatro Vizago]], who assumed Jarrus had already defeated Proach. As the pair spoke, the Trandoshan attacked Jarrus from behind, lashing at him with his [[electro-whip]], which the Jedi managed to block with his [[Kanan Jarrus' lightsaber|lightsaber]]. As Jarrus blocked, Proach's whip wrapped around the [[lightsaber]]'s handle, allowing the Trandoshan to jerk it from Jarrus's hand and disarm him. Proach then wrapped the whip around Jarrus with a second lash and shocked him with it, causing the Jedi to collapse. ===Clash of the titans=== {{Quote|Kanan! Up here!''"
"''I'm coming Zeb! Hang on!|Garazeb Orrelios shouts to Kanan Jarrus while fighting Proach|}} [[File:Proach_vs_Kanan.png|thumb|right|270px|Proach stands over an incapacitated Jarrus.]] As the foreman loomed over his incapacitated foe, Orrelios opened fire with his [[bo-rifle]] from one of the walkways above, distracting the Trandoshan. Using his whip, Proach then pulled himself up to the Lasat's level and charged at him, engaging him in [[unarmed combat]] and disarming him. Orrelios then rushed at Proach and lifted the Trandoshan, charging him out onto an open walkway between the two sections of the crawler. Proach then suplexed the Lasat and after the pair exchanged several more blows, the Trandoshan gained the upper hand and began slamming Orrelios's head repeatedly into a metal bar before trying to drop him over the edge of the walkway. Orrelios managed to freed himself using his feet, then grab Proach with his [[Limb|legs]] and pull him over the edge as well. With both combatants now hanging beneath the walkway, they again began to exchange blows. Jarrus then ran out on another walkway below the pair, and after Orrelios shouted down to him, the Jedi dashed off to try and reach the fight. Proach then drew out his whip and began trying to hit the Lasat with it, eventually ensnaring his foe's arm and beginning to shock and pull Orrelios so that he would fall. Resisting the shock, the Rebel yanked the whip and dragged Proach forward into a metal bar, causing him to fall from the walkway. With the Trandoshan now only hanging on to the whip wrapped around Orrelios's arm, the Lasat began to struggle to hold on while bearing both their weights. Fortunately for the Rebel, Proach's strength gave out first and the Trandoshan tumbled to his [[death]] in the smoky depths of the crawler below. Orrelios then also lost his hold, but was caught by Jarrus before he could fall. After Seevor was killed while trying to sabotage the crawler, the Rebels successfully took control of the entire vehicle. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|You got a big surprise coming.|Seevor hints at Proach's presence on the crawler|}} Proach was a ruthless and agile{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/crawler-commandeers-episode-gallery|text="Crawler Commandeers" Episode Gallery}} {{C|slide 6}} [[Slavery|slave]] driver who was both an imposing presence and a deadly warrior. He had [[Color|green]] skin, orange [[eye]]s and stood taller than Garazeb Orrelios, who was 2.1 [[meter]]s tall.''[[Star Wars Rebels: The Visual Guide]]'' The Trandoshan appeared greatly afraid while hanging from just his whip, and cried out in terror as he fell. ==Equipment== Proach wore a yellow and blue Mining Guild [[Clothing|uniform]] including a [[Armor|helmet]]. He used an electro-whip. At one point, he flew a TIE/mg Mining Guild starfighter. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Star-wars-rebels-408-trivia-gallery-5_85a08597.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Pat Roach, whom Proach was named after, as he appeared in ''Raiders of the Lost Ark''.]] Proach first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' episode "[[Crawler Commandeers]]" and was voiced by [[Clancy Brown]]. His character name is a tribute to actor [[w:c:indianajones:Pat Roach|Pat Roach]], who played the [[w:c:indianajones:Giant Sherpa|Giant Sherpa]] and the [[w:c:indianajones:German Mechanic|burly mechanic]] that [[Indiana Jones]] brawls with in the [[1981]] film [[w:c:indianajones:Raiders of the Lost Ark|''Raiders of the Lost Ark'']], the [[w:c:indianajones:Chief Guard|Chief Guard]] in the [[1984]] film [[w:c:indianajones:Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom|''Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom'']] and the [[w:c:indianajones:Gestapo (individual)|Gestapo]] in the [[1989]] film [[w:c:indianajones:Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade|''Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade'']].{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/crawler-commandeers-trivia-gallery|text="Crawler Commandeers" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|slide 5}} ==Appearances== *{{Rebels|Crawler Commandeers}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/crawler-commandeers-episode-guide|text="Crawler Commandeers" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}} *{{FFGXW2|set=Mining Guild TIE Expansion Pack|cardname=Foreman Proach}} *''[[The Art of Star Wars Rebels]]'' *{{Databank|guild-slave-master-proach|Guild Slave Master Proach}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *{{IndyWiki|Pat Roach|Pat Roach}} {{Interlang |ja=プローチ }} [[Category:Enslavers]] [[Category:Foremans]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Mining Guild employees]] [[Category:Trandoshans]]
